description: Source code for KafkaDataConsumer trait and InternalKafkaConsumer class, implementing Kafka consumer logic for Spark Streaming Kafka integration, including caching and offset management.

classes.name: KafkaDataConsumer
classes.description: Sealed trait defining Kafka consumer operations such as get, start, next, previous, and release.

classes.name: InternalKafkaConsumer
classes.description: Class wrapping Kafka's KafkaConsumer, managing offsets, buffering, seeking, polling, and lifecycle for a specific topic partition.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetch a record at a specific offset with a timeout.

methods.name: compactedStart
methods.description: Initialize a batch on a compacted Kafka topic starting at a specific offset.

methods.name: compactedNext
methods.description: Retrieve the next record in a compacted topic batch.

methods.name: compactedPrevious
methods.description: Rewind to the previous record in a compacted topic batch.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Release or close the consumer, depending on implementation.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Create a KafkaConsumer instance with updated configs.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seek to a specific offset in the topic partition.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Poll Kafka for records with a specified timeout.
